// diagnostic

E0605

Item or field is private to its module (`priv module` or `priv` field)

What

Item or field is private to its module (`priv module` or `priv` field)

Why

A `priv module` is usable only by its enclosing module (`priv(package)`: by its package), and a `priv` field only by its type's module

Fix

Use it from inside its enclosing module, or remove `priv` from the module or field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0605: tests/ui/forged_file_writer_literal/stderr.

Error [jet.ComputedFieldAssigned]: `path` is a computed field on `FileWriter` — it can't be set
  --> tests/ui/forged_file_writer_literal/run.jet:6:24
    |
  6 |     forged: FileWriter{path: "/etc/passwd"}
    |                        ^^^^
 Why: `path` is declared `path -> …` — its value always comes from that formula, never from a struct literal
 Fix: Remove `path` from this `.{ … }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0339

Error [jet.PrivateItem]: `FileWriter` can't be built here: its field `stored_path` is private to its module
  --> tests/ui/forged_file_writer_literal/run.jet:6:13
    |
  6 |     forged: FileWriter{path: "/etc/passwd"}
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `priv module` is usable only by its enclosing module (`priv(package)`: by its package), and a `priv` field only by its type's module
 Fix: Get a `FileWriter` from a function of its module, or remove `priv` from `stored_path`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0605
